name: photostudio-manager-desktop
description: PhotoStudio Manager - Windows desktop app for photographers
author: PhotoStudio Manager

scripts.build:x64: npm run build:core && npm run prepare:core && electron-builder --win --x64 --config.directories.output=dist-windows/x64
scripts.build:x86: npm run build:core && npm run prepare:core && electron-builder --win --ia32 --config.directories.output=dist-windows/x86
scripts.build: npm run build:x64 && npm run build:x86
